about: From power-on: the logos, the intro and the title screen, Start there, then the main menu as a player with a saved name reaches it: right through all seven choices, left twice, and A, through its fade to black. The name entry isn't ported, so the original is given a saved name (see onlyInOriginal).

onlyInOriginal.about: A name already saved, which the name entry keeps at 0x03002170, so the title screen's Start goes straight to the menu, by way of the one frame the name entry takes to see it.
